change: Tightened Revisit Tracker auto-detection: (1) excludes generic action/positional words (replaced, repaired, checked, front, side, etc.) from the similarity match, so it now requires a shared component-specific word instead of any 4+ letter word in common — fixes false positives like 'replaced headlamp' matching 'replaced gearbox bolt'; (2) when a truck has multiple past inspections, now always keeps the CLOSEST (most recent) matching visit instead of whichever is checked first, so a genuinely urgent recent repeat failure can no longer get silently masked by an older distant match. Applies to new inspections going forward — existing revisit records already logged are unchanged.
